title: flight.event
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). One flight event for the phone feed: lift-off, Max Q, staging, engine-out, abort, touchdown and so on, with its fact moment.

eventId.description: Event id from the game data (e.g. "engine_out", "meco").

flightPhase.description: Flight phase in which it happened.

metS.description: Mission elapsed time in seconds (negative before lift-off).

factId.description: Fact moment to show; null when none.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

FlightPhase.description: Flight phase (§9.1). F0–F1 belong to COUNTDOWN, F2–F13 to FLIGHT. The parallel booster-return track F7b is signalled by `boosterTrack`, not by a value here; F14 is the DEBRIEF phase.

TextRef.description: Reference to localised player-visible text. The protocol never carries free display text: `key` is a key of `data/strings/<lang>.json`, and `args` supplies substitution values. Receivers format numbers and units locally.

args.description: Substitution values by placeholder name. String values must themselves be data ids or string-table keys, never user text.
